source_snapshot.procedure: Set BIOS CPU performance mode, run stress-ng, check CPU threshold in BMC SEL.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: CRITICAL conditional execution requiring bounded workload, threshold/severity and recovery.

old_problem: Neither the exact BIOS change and rollback nor the stress-ng recipe, intended sensor threshold, assertion/deassertion severity, hysteresis/timing or safe thermal envelope is defined; normal stress may correctly produce no threshold event.
disposition_reason: ED-14 forbids replacing a defined stress interval with an ad-hoc smoke run and ED-15 forbids PASS without a threshold. Generic stress-ng/IPMI references cannot decide whether assertion is required or safely define the platform sensor/severity, so the missing core oracle remains pending.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2249 and 2250, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical record and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve BIOS performance-mode, CPU stress and BMC SEL severity coverage.
Require a signed stressor/workers/affinity/duration and continuous temperature/power/frequency/fan monitoring with abort margins below hardware limits.
Require one sensor-specific SEL assertion/deassertion/severity/hysteresis/timing oracle and an explicit decision whether no event under safe load passes or fails.
Record/restore BIOS state and preserve SEL baseline; do not clear evidence, disable protection, impair cooling or escalate load until an event appears.
No BIOS change, stress, SEL query, reboot or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Bounded CPU threshold-event severity under approved performance profile
test_case.purpose: Apply one approved bounded CPU workload in the signed BIOS profile and correlate safe live telemetry with the exact expected BMC CPU threshold event and severity.
required_package: stress-ng version and exact workers/stressor/affinity/duration recipe
Sensor threshold/hysteresis, SEL payload/severity/timing and thermal/power/fan abort envelope
test_case.test_command: Only after explicit one-shot approval, apply the signed BIOS profile, verify OS/cooling, capture baseline SEL/telemetry, run the exact bounded stress-ng command once with live abort enforcement, cool down, decode new SEL events, then restore/finalize BIOS as approved.
test_case.expected_result: The workload stays inside the signed safety envelope and the mapped CPU sensor exhibits exactly the approved assertion/no-assertion behavior, severity, timing and deassertion, followed by cooldown and healthy final state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the approved workload and threshold oracle, complete synchronized telemetry/SEL evidence and verified final state. Any missing threshold/severity/no-event policy keeps Pending. Overtemperature, cooling fault, unexpected reset/hang, wrong event or failed recovery is FAIL.
safety_gate: Dedicated drained DUT, independent console and verified cooling.
One signed bounded run only; no automatic retry.
Abort at supplied pre-limit temperature/power/fan/error conditions.
Never obstruct cooling, disable protections or clear SEL.
expected_evidence: Cooldown, recovery, BIOS restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: On thermal, fan, hang or power anomaly stop load immediately, preserve console/SEL/telemetry, cool the DUT and use only the pre-approved console/BIOS recovery; do not rerun.

source_conflict.reason: The source consistently links performance mode, CPU stress and SEL severity; it omits rather than contradicts the oracle.

blocked.reason: The exact recipe/oracle are supplyable, but execution remains gated until approved.
